title: MONTHLY ENTERPRISE CYBERSECURITY
THREAT INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY
report.sourceNote: Compiled automatically from CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD, VulnCheck, Metasploit, Exploit-DB, PoC-in-GitHub and MITRE ATT&CK. Counts are catalog counts, not a count of cyber incidents; anything the sources do not establish is stated as not established.

blocks.text: CISA added **31 vulnerabilities** to the KEV catalog in August 2026, spanning 23 vendors. CISA flags known ransomware use for 2 of them. The highest-likelihood additions by EPSS were **CVE-2026-8037 (Progress LoadMaster)** and **CVE-2026-72898 (Metabase)**. Outside KEV, 4 further CVEs were reported exploited or tracked as zero-days by Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD or VulnCheck.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-8037 - Progress LoadMaster command injection (CVSS 9.8).** OS Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in API in Progress ADC Products allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): connection manager for objectscale 7.2.63.2, ecs connection manager 7.2.63.2, moveit web application firewall 7.2.63.2, loadmaster 7.2.54.18. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-72898 - Metabase SQL injection (CVSS 10).** Metabase allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to inject arbitrary SQL via the '/reset_password' database endpoint and gain administrator access to the connected Metabase instance. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): metabase 0.58.24, metabase 0.59.21, metabase 0.60.17, metabase 0.61.11. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-34486 - Apache Tomcat Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability (CVSS 7.5).** Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data vulnerability in Apache Tomcat due to the fix for CVE-2026-29146 allowing the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This issue affects Apache Tomcat: 11.0.20, 10.1.53, 9.0.116. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.21, 10.1.54 or 9.0.117, which fix the issue. Fixed package release: not mapped in NVD ranges; 1 vendor patch or advisory reference available. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
KEV additions by week: week of Aug 3: 6; week of Aug 10: 3; week of Aug 17: 9; week of Aug 24: 11; week of Aug 31: 2.
Known ransomware use (CISA): CVE-2026-63077 (JetBrains TeamCity) and CVE-2026-59310 (Broadcom VMware vCenter).
No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds. Victim counts and campaign scope are not established unless cited in section 5.

**Defensive hunting focus:** unexpected child processes and outbound connections (12 CVEs); unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes (7 CVEs); unusual requests and changes (7 CVEs).
